price_selection_rule: Prefer fixed 50/50 futures-tree ensemble if within one paired standard error of development minimum.
policy_robustness_rule: Prefer hedged50 within one paired standard error when its worst development-window fill is no worse.
policy_recommendation_reason: Explicit fixed50/50 hedge after retrospective stress tests; export development-mean winner separately. The hedge sacrifices some development mean for protection against missed shocks.
